references.text: The parable of the fig tree that Jesus uses in Matthew is parallel to Mark 13:29, and teaches that one should recognize the signs that the end times are approaching.
Luke also gives a similar parable about the fig tree and other trees, indicating that one should understand when the kingdom of God is near.
Isaiah warns to be attentive to the signs from the Lord, which can be seen as a parallel to recognizing the signs of the end times mentioned in Mark 13:29.
